slides.texte_overlay:
Underrated skills that make
a young man unstoppable
Writing clearly. Emails, messages, cover letters. People who write clearly get answers faster and look more professional.
Managing your energy. Knowing when you focus best and planning hard tasks for that time. It's like having extra hours.
Asking good questions. In meetings, interviews and dates. Good questions make you look smart and help you learn faster.
Staying calm under pressure. Deadlines, conflicts, emergencies. The calm one is always the one people trust with more.
Before: I knew very little outside my job. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I can hold my own in any conversation.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I knew very little outside my job. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I can hold my own in any conversation.

slides.texte_overlay: Finishing what you start. Most people stop halfway. Simply finishing projects puts you ahead of the majority. Finish one thing this week.
Building good habits early. Sleep, training, saving, reading. Habits started in your 20s carry you for decades. Start now.
